text.en: This Order may be cited as the Emergency (Public Offi.cers (Liabilities) Act (Repeal)) Order. 2000. Repeal of Chapter 80.

The Public Offi.cers (Liabilities) Act (Chapter 80) is hereby repealed. Made this 20th. day of Safar, 1421 Hijriah corresponding to the 24th. day of May, 2000 at Our Istana Nurul Iman. Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
